source: Art direction for the 20 approved themes (29 Oct 2026, rewritten). Text-free. Colours come only from colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 of the clip. Edges fade out over 140 px, so keep the main subject inside that margin.

Dragon Storm.scene: A dragon coils through a storm cloud above a dark ridge, its head turned toward the viewer.
Dragon Storm.composition: Dragon body curves from bottom left up to the top right. Head sits in the upper right third. Wings open toward both sides.
Dragon Storm.back: Thick storm clouds with rolled edges, in shades of colour 1 and colour 2.
Dragon Storm.middle: Forked lightning and drifting sparks. The brightest bolt uses colour 3.
Dragon Storm.front: Dragon scales, claws and horns in bold ink outline, with colour 1 and colour 2 fills.

Serpent River.scene: A giant serpent rises out of a fast, rocky river.
Serpent River.composition: Serpent forms an S-curve from the bottom edge up to the top right, with its head highest.
Serpent River.back: Rocky banks and rushing water in deep tones of colour 1.
Serpent River.middle: Foam and spray in pale tints of colour 2 and colour 3.
Serpent River.front: Serpent body with a bold scale pattern in ink. Scale highlights use colour 2.

Nine-Tail Fox.scene: A fox with nine tails fans out behind it under a night sky.
Nine-Tail Fox.composition: Fox centred, tails spread in a wide arc behind it. Fox face sits in the middle third.
Nine-Tail Fox.back: Night sky with a large moon, in deep tones of colour 1.
Nine-Tail Fox.middle: Tails with flame-like tips in colour 2 and colour 3.
Nine-Tail Fox.front: Fox head, eyes and paws in bold ink. Fur marks in sharp colour 2.

Tengu Sky Clash.scene: Two tengu warriors clash in mid-air above a temple roof.
Tengu Sky Clash.composition: Warriors on a diagonal, facing each other. Their weapons cross at the centre.
Tengu Sky Clash.back: Sky and clouds in soft tones of colour 1.
Tengu Sky Clash.middle: Feather and dust bursts. Colour 2 and colour 3 sparks where the blades meet.
Tengu Sky Clash.front: Warriors, masks and weapons in sharp ink, with colour 1 and colour 2 fills.

Neon Rain City.scene: A rainy street at night, lit by signs with no readable letters.
Neon Rain City.composition: Street runs from the bottom edge to a vanishing point at the centre. Buildings frame both sides.
Neon Rain City.back: Dark buildings and falling rain lines in deep colour 1.
Neon Rain City.middle: Neon glow and reflections on wet ground, in colour 2 and colour 3.
Neon Rain City.front: A silhouette figure with an umbrella, with a sharp ink edge and light from behind.

Samurai Petal Storm.scene: A samurai stands still while a storm of cherry petals swirls around him.
Samurai Petal Storm.composition: Samurai in the centre, seen from a slight low angle, blade raised.
Samurai Petal Storm.back: Petal storm in pale tints of colour 2 and colour 1.
Samurai Petal Storm.middle: Wind swirls and loose petals in colour 3 and colour 2.
Samurai Petal Storm.front: Samurai armour and raised blade in bold ink, with colour 1 fills.

Kaiju Skyline.scene: A huge kaiju towers over a city skyline at dusk.
Kaiju Skyline.composition: Kaiju on the right, head in the upper third. Skyline runs low across the left and bottom.
Kaiju Skyline.back: Dusk sky gradient from colour 1 to colour 2, with far buildings in dark tones.
Kaiju Skyline.middle: Smoke, dust and drifting sparks in pale colour 3 tints.
Kaiju Skyline.front: Kaiju body in a roaring pose, bold ink, with colour 1 and colour 2 fills.

Mecha Hangar Duel.scene: Two mecha face off inside a large hangar.
Mecha Hangar Duel.composition: Mechs stand left and right, facing the centre. The gap between them is the focal point.
Mecha Hangar Duel.back: Hangar walls, ribbed beams and lights in dark colour 1.
Mecha Hangar Duel.middle: Sparks and steam clouds in colour 2 and colour 3 tints.
Mecha Hangar Duel.front: Mech armour plates in bold ink, with colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3 panels.

Fleet Nebula.scene: A fleet of ships sails through a bright nebula.
Fleet Nebula.composition: Ships in a V shape. The leading ship sits at the centre and the others trail behind it.
Fleet Nebula.back: Nebula clouds in layered tones of colour 1 and colour 2.
Fleet Nebula.middle: Stars, light trails and small glowing dust.
Fleet Nebula.front: Ship hulls with clean, sharp outlines. Running lights in colour 3.

Sunken Temple.scene: An old temple sits deep under water, with light rays coming down from above.
Sunken Temple.composition: Temple at the bottom centre. Light rays fall from the top edge toward it.
Sunken Temple.back: Deep water gradient, dark colour 1 at the bottom and lighter colour 2 at the top.
Sunken Temple.middle: Bubbles and light rays in pale tints of colour 2.
Sunken Temple.front: Temple columns and roof in bold ink, with colour 3 carvings.

Ghost Pirate Storm.scene: A ghost ship sails through a storm at night.
Ghost Pirate Storm.composition: Ship on a diagonal from top left to bottom right, with waves below it.
Ghost Pirate Storm.back: Storm sky with heavy clouds in deep colour 1.
Ghost Pirate Storm.middle: Lightning bolts and sea spray in colour 2 and colour 3 tints.
Ghost Pirate Storm.front: Ship and ghostly pirates in bold ink. Pale colour 2 glow around the ghosts.

Frost Phoenix.scene: A phoenix made of ice and frost rises over snowy peaks.
Frost Phoenix.composition: Phoenix centred, wings spread to both edges. Peaks sit low along the bottom.
Frost Phoenix.back: Snow peaks and a pale sky in colour 1 and colour 2 tints.
Frost Phoenix.middle: Ice shards, mist and frost sparkle in colour 3.
Frost Phoenix.front: Phoenix feathers in bold ink, with colour 2 and colour 1 fills.

Demon Gate.scene: A huge gate stands open on a dark land, with demons waiting at its base.
Demon Gate.composition: Gate tall and centred. Demons gather at the bottom centre, half hidden in smoke.
Demon Gate.back: Dark sky and cracked land in deep colour 1.
Demon Gate.middle: Smoke and rising embers in colour 2 and colour 3.
Demon Gate.front: Gate frame and demon shapes in bold ink. Colour 2 glow shows through the opening.

Spirit Sakura Forest.scene: A forest of cherry trees, with spirit lights floating between the trunks.
Spirit Sakura Forest.composition: A path leads from the bottom edge into the centre, with trees framing both sides.
Spirit Sakura Forest.back: Trees and a soft sky in colour 1 and colour 2 tints.
Spirit Sakura Forest.middle: Falling petals and glowing spirit lights in colour 3.
Spirit Sakura Forest.front: A spirit figure standing on the path, with a sharp ink outline.

Shattered Clock.scene: A giant clock breaks into pieces that fly outward through the air.
Shattered Clock.composition: Clock face centred, pieces flying out toward the edges. The clock face has no numerals.
Shattered Clock.back: Plain sky gradient from colour 1 to colour 2.
Shattered Clock.middle: Shards and dust in colour 2 and colour 3 tints, with motion trails.
Shattered Clock.front: Clock rings and gear teeth in bold ink, with colour 1 and colour 3 metal.

Beast Arena.scene: Two beasts fight inside a round arena, with a crowd shape around the edge.
Beast Arena.composition: Arena ring centred. Beasts stand left and right, facing each other.
Beast Arena.back: Arena walls and crowd shapes in dark colour 1.
Beast Arena.middle: Dust clouds and sparks in colour 2 and colour 3 tints.
Beast Arena.front: Beasts in bold ink, with colour 2 and colour 1 fills.

Black Hole.scene: A black hole pulls light and stars inward.
Black Hole.composition: Hole centred. Light spirals in from the edges toward it.
Black Hole.back: Star field in deep colour 1, with small pale stars.
Black Hole.middle: Light streaks bending toward the centre in colour 2 and colour 3.
Black Hole.front: Dark core with a bold rim. The rim has a bright colour 3 edge.

Griffin Sky.scene: A griffin dives across a wide open sky.
Griffin Sky.composition: Griffin on a diagonal from top left to bottom right, wings open.
Griffin Sky.back: Clouds and sky gradient in colour 1 and colour 2.
Griffin Sky.middle: Wind lines and feather trails in colour 3 tints.
Griffin Sky.front: Griffin body and wings in bold ink, with colour 2 and colour 1 fills.

Spirit Wolf Aurora.scene: A spirit wolf howls under a bright aurora.
Spirit Wolf Aurora.composition: Wolf centre low, head raised. Aurora bands arc across the top.
Spirit Wolf Aurora.back: Aurora bands in layered tones of colour 1, colour 2 and colour 3.
Spirit Wolf Aurora.middle: Snow and drifting light specks in pale tints.
Spirit Wolf Aurora.front: Wolf in bold ink, with a colour 2 glow along its outline.

Rooftop Speed Lines.scene: Two figures race across rooftops, with speed lines trailing behind them.
Rooftop Speed Lines.composition: Figures on a diagonal, rooftops below them and sky above.
Rooftop Speed Lines.back: Sky and roof shapes in colour 1 and colour 2 tints.
Rooftop Speed Lines.middle: Speed lines in colour 3 and colour 1.
Rooftop Speed Lines.front: Figures in a running pose, bold ink, with colour 2 fills.
